title: Migrate testbed from PAT to GitHub App
description: Install App on testbed-multi-org. Update strspc-central config (auth.method: github-app) and workflow (replace SYNC_TOKEN with App secrets). Verify token exchange, permission validation, PRs with App bot identity. Ref: GH #22.

title: Register GitHub App (infra)
description: Create GitHub App under SteerSpec or testbed org. Permissions: contents:write, pull_requests:write, issues:write, metadata:read, members:read. No webhooks. Generate private key, store in testbed secrets. Ref: GH #22.

title: Validate GitHub App permissions post-auth (GH #18)
description: After token exchange, call GET /installation to check granted permissions. Require contents:write, pull_requests:write, issues:write, metadata:read. Fail fast with clear error. Files: internal/github/client.go. Ref: GH #18, GH #22.

title: Fingerprint-based issue idempotency (GH #17)
description: Generate BLAKE3 fingerprint from (type, repo, filePath, conflictType), embed as HTML comment in issue body, search before creating. Apply to both conflict and monitor. Files: internal/conflict/conflict.go, internal/monitor/monitor.go. Ref: GH #17, GH #22.

title: Add operation-level timeout (GH #16)
description: Add --timeout CLI flag (default 10m) wrapping command context. Per-request 30s timeout already exists. Files: cmd/strspc/main.go. Ref: GH #16, GH #22.

title: Enhance rate limiter with proactive awareness (GH #15)
description: Rate limiter is wired in but only reactive. Add proactive X-RateLimit-Remaining/Reset reading, preemptive sleep before hitting limits, Retry-After for secondary limits. Files: internal/github/client.go. Ref: GH #15, GH #22.

title: Fix central repo derivation (GH #14)
description: sync.go:231 uses splitRepo(Include[0]) which breaks on globs. Add central-repo config field, resolve from config > GITHUB_REPOSITORY > error. Files: internal/config/config.go, internal/sync/sync.go, cmd/strspc/main.go. Ref: GH #14, GH #22.

title: PI: Phase 2 — GitHub App Completion
description: Complete the GitHub App transition: permission validation, app registration, testbed migration from PAT to App. Ref: GH #22 (PI plan), GH #18.

title: PI: Phase 1 — Reliability Hardening
description: Fix reliability gaps identified by narigon before GitHub App rollout. All 4 items are independent and parallelizable. Ref: GH #22 (PI plan), GH #14, #15, #16, #17.

title: fix: action binary download — version resolution and asset name (GH #12)
description: Two bugs prevent the GitHub Action from working. Bug 1: github.action_ref is empty in composite sub-actions, so VERSION is blank. Fix: read from VERSION file. Bug 2: goreleaser uses ProjectName (strspc-sync) but actions download strspc_*. Fix: hardcode strspc in name_template.
notes: v0.1.1 released via GoReleaser (run 22823237778). Archives strspc_0.1.1_* published. Action usable as SteerSpec/strspc-sync/sync@v0.1.1.
close_reason: Fixed in commit 50e526c. Goreleaser name_template now hardcodes strspc; all 4 action files read VERSION from file instead of github.action_ref.

title: SYNCPR-002: per-template version in branch names
description: Implement SYNCPR-002 spec requirement: branch name must include template version (steerspec-sync/<id>/<version>). Requires adding Version field to TemplateConfig, updating sync.go branch name format, populating TemplateState.Version, unskipping TestSYNCPR002_BranchNameFormat_KnownDeviation. References GH #4.
